labels: Three views of the unwell child
forbiddenAnatomy: Organs, joints, bones, tissue layers, histology, clinical photographs

checks: Three domains correctly named; breathing is work not merely rate.
Circulation focuses on visible skin appearance; no heartbeat icon implying pulse examination alone.
No claim that rapid impression replaces ABCDE or urgent care.
validation.pixelReviewNotes: Triangle correctly locates appearance, work of breathing and circulation to skin around a non-anatomical wooden token. Supporting labels reflect interaction/tone/cry, effort/sounds, colour/mottling. Exit arrow calls for assessment, action and reassessment. Swatches are abstract paint, not purported diagnostic skin photographs; no pulse-only circulation substitution.
